text.p: Australia took a two-one lead in the Ashes series on Monday when they beat England by an innings and 61 runs in the fourth test at Headingley.
Victory was completed with the first ball after lunch on the final day, Paul Reiffel having Robert Croft caught behind for five to collect his fifth wicket of the innings.

Nasser Hussain (105) and John Crawley (72), who had offered England the possibility of surviving for a draw with their fifth-wicket stand on the fourth day, were unable to stay long enough to turn that into reality.
The fifth test at Trent Bridge, Nottingham, starts on August 7.
